Heidi Klum Marks 25th Annual Halloween Party With Severed Hand Costume

A Quarter-Century of Costume Innovation

Supermodel and television personality Heidi Klum celebrated the 25th anniversary of her annual Halloween party by debuting a costume designed to resemble a realistic severed human hand. The event, held in New York City, continues a long-standing tradition of high-concept, prosthetic-heavy looks that have become a hallmark of her public persona.

Historical Costume Context

Klum is widely recognized for her elaborate and resource-intensive Halloween transformations. Previous iterations of her costumes have included:

  • Mythological figures: Such as her 2025 appearance as Medusa.
  • Pop culture icons: Including characters like Jessica Rabbit, E.T., and Princess Fiona from *Shrek*.
  • Naturalistic interpretations: Such as a peacock, a butterfly, and a worm.

Regarding the ephemeral nature of these designs, Klum has previously noted that the intricate work involved in these prosthetics is intended for a single night of use, emphasizing the artistic process over the longevity of the final product.

Career Background

Outside of her annual event, Klum maintains a significant presence in television production and fashion. Her professional credits include:

  • Project Runway: Returning as a judge for the series' 22nd season.
  • Making the Cut: A fashion competition collaboration with Tim Gunn for Prime Video, which spanned three seasons.

Verification

Readers interested in the visual documentation of this year’s costume or official statements regarding the anniversary event can verify details through official social media accounts associated with Heidi Klum or through entertainment news outlets that cover annual celebrity event photography.
